name: Data Journalism
description: White ground, serif headlines, one strong accent and neutral greys so the data carries the colour; strict hierarchy for charts, maps and comparisons.

tokens.texture: None; thin rules and subtle tints only
tokens.spacing: --u = 1% of short side; --gap; safe-area insets per format

motion.personality: Clear and sequential: reveal the data in the order of the argument
motion.notes: Draw lines and bars with linear or near-linear easing so slopes are not distorted; annotate after the shape lands.

validation.evidence: Contrast ratios computed from the stylesheet hex values with src/pipeline/colorscience.py (WCAG 2.x), 2026-11-02. Not yet used in a rendered project.
